hook: A popcorn kernel bursts in a hot pan, then pops a soap bubble in about a hundredth of a second. Slowed 1,000 times, you can watch the hole race around it.

titles.text: Popcorn vs. a Soap Bubble, in Slow Motion
What Really Happens When Popcorn Pops
The Hole That Races Around a Bubble at About 16 mph
Why Does a Bubble Pop From a Hole?
A Soap Bubble's Rainbow Is 100 Times Thinner Than a Hair
